title: Dispatch CLI subcommands before openStore(); start the MCP server by importing it
trigger: When adding or changing a subcommand in src/cli.js, or starting the MCP server from another entry point
behavior_delta: Dispatch any subcommand that must not touch the current directory's project (help, version, install, mcp, resident) before main() in src/cli.js reaches openStore(), and refuse unknown commands there too: openStore() creates .dd/ and a data directory in whatever directory the CLI runs from. Start the MCP server with a side-effecting await import('./mcp/server.js'); it is a top-level-await script with no exported entry point.
what: Dispatch any subcommand that must not touch the current directory's project (help, version, install, mcp, resident) before main() in src/cli.js reaches openStore(), and refuse unknown commands there too: openStore() creates .dd/ and a data directory in whatever directory the CLI runs from. Start the MCP server with a side-effecting await import('./mcp/server.js'); it is a top-level-await script with no exported entry point.
why: 0.8.3 fixed exactly this trap: an unknown command, --help or --version created .dd/ and a data directory in the current directory before refusing. src/mcp/server.js opens its store and connects the stdio transport when imported and exports nothing to call. The previous version also described the Grok marketplace files as they were before the 2026-09-19 install work; those details were fixed long ago and live in integrations/grok/manifest-traps.
trigger_variants: Agregar un comando nuevo a deltadictum
Start the MCP server from the CLI

evidence_refs.summary: main() handles help, version, install, mcp, resident and unknown commands before openStore().
Top-level await: opens the store and connects the stdio transport on import; no exports.
0.8.3 Fixed: unknown command, --help or --version no longer create .dd/ and a data directory.
